# git: alias: refactor alias.configure and alias.aliases

Part of [#355](DOT-354.md): move `configure` (runs [git_config](../../bin/git_config) itself) and `aliases` (pretty-prints the alias list through the `git_aliases` Python script, [#19](DOT-19.md)) into a new `bin/lib/git/init.bash`, and decide whether `aliases` is worth keeping. Action items to plan alongside: the config-based flow [#174](DOT-173.md), the `git` proxy [#136](DOT-135.md), rethinking aliases with external tools [#139](DOT-138.md).
